title: Dad nabbed in Pampanga for allegedly taking ex-partner's 2 kids
summary: MABALACAT CITY — Police arrested a 37-year-old man for allegedly taking his former partner’s two children without her consent in Pasay City and bringing them to San Fernando City in…

blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY — Police arrested a 37-year-old man for allegedly taking his former partner’s two children without her consent in Pasay City and bringing them to San Fernando City in Pampanga. In a statement, the Philippine National Police Public Information Office (PNP-PIO) said the children, aged 11 and three, were taken without their mother knowing about it. The suspect allegedly brought the children, aged 11 and three years old, to Barangay Malpitic, where Pasay City police officers, with assistance from San Fernando police, rescued the kids on October 26.
